message.simpleskills.vein_mining.unlocke: Vein Mining unlocked! Hold Shift while mining to break up to %s additional connected ores.
message.simpleskills.vein_mining.improve: Vein Mining improved! Hold Shift while mining to break up to %s additional connected ores.
message.simpleskills.tree_feller.unlocke: Tree Feller unlocked! Hold Shift and break a tree trunk with an axe to make the entire tree fall.
message.simpleskills.bone_meal_mastery.u: Bone Meal Mastery unlocked! Hold any hoe and right-click a compatible crop to grow it just like bone meal - no bone meal needed in your inventory. It costs hunger depending on your Farming level and becomes free at level 20.
message.simpleskills.auto_plant.unlocked: Auto Plant unlocked! Hold any hoe and left-click a fully grown crop on farmland: it is harvested and replanted automatically using a seed from its own drops - no seeds needed in your inventory.
message.simpleskills.bone_meal_mastery.n: Not enough hunger to use Bone Meal Mastery (it costs %s hunger points).
